verdict.rationale: Calendly publishes its own per-endpoint API reference for its REST API v2, with method and URL listed for endpoints such as create, list, and delete webhook subscriptions, plus a sample-data test endpoint. It also offers machine-readable Markdown and llms.txt versions that suit AI-native use. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or lets users run requests from the docs. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, and any hands-on corroboration that examples can be run from the reference.
